# Praxis Loten — Physiotherapy & Manual Therapy in Eupen (Belgium)

> Praxis Loten is a physiotherapy and manual-therapy practice in Eupen, in the German-speaking Community of Belgium (Ostbelgien). Five therapists deliver evidence-based physiotherapy (EBP): manual therapy, sports rehabilitation, temporomandibular (jaw / CMD) therapy, manual lymphatic drainage, and structured post-operative rehabilitation. Patients are cared for in German, French, Dutch and English; the website is available in 10 languages. Address: Loten 1, 4700 Eupen, Belgium. Phone: +32 87 55 56 70. Email: praxisloten@gmail.com. Hours: Monday–Friday 07:30–20:30. Canonical URLs use a language prefix (e.g. /de, /fr, /en); replace the prefix to switch language.

## About / À propos / Über uns
- [The practice / Le cabinet / Die Praxis](https://www.praxisloten.be/de/praxis): who we are and our evidence-based, biopsychosocial approach.
- [Contact & booking](https://www.praxisloten.be/de/contact): phone, WhatsApp and online booking, plus each therapist's direct details.
- [Book an appointment / Prendre rendez-vous / Termin](https://www.praxisloten.be/de/termin): choose by reason (back, sport, drainage, jaw, hand/elbow/ankle…) then by contact method.
- [Fees / Honoraires / Honorare](https://www.praxisloten.be/de/honoraires): INAMI/RIZIV conventioned tariffs.

## Services / Prestations / Leistungen
- [Manual therapy](https://www.praxisloten.be/de/leistungen/manuelle-therapie): OMT-qualified manual therapy for spine and joints.
- [Sports physiotherapy](https://www.praxisloten.be/de/leistungen/sport-kinesitherapie): injury rehabilitation and return-to-sport.
- [Jaw / TMJ (CMD)](https://www.praxisloten.be/de/leistungen/kiefergelenk): temporomandibular dysfunction and orofacial pain.
- [Manual lymphatic drainage](https://www.praxisloten.be/de/leistungen/lymphdrainage): post-operative care and lymphedema.
- [Rehabilitation](https://www.praxisloten.be/de/rehabilitation): structured programs for hip, knee, ACL and shoulder.
